glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) – a vertical stroke and a horizontal stroke bisecting each other – original character of 切 (“to cut”). The top-most horizontal stroke is done from left to right. The vertical stroke and bottom-most horizontal stroke are done as one stroke, from top-left to bottom-right.
